title: Beef Anticuchos with a Twist
description: A fusion of Peruvian anticuchos and Chinese flavors, these beef skewers are a unique twist on a classic dish.

ingredients.name: beef
ingredients.notes: thinly sliced beef (such as flank steak)

ingredients.name: peruvian
ingredients.notes: aji amarillo pepper paste (or to taste)

instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together soy sauce, aji amarillo pepper paste, and Peruvian anticuchos seasoning.
3. Add the sliced beef to the marinade and toss to coat.
5. Brush the grill with vegetable oil to prevent sticking.
6. Grill the beef for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to desired level of doneness.
7. Transfer the beef to a plate and sprinkle with brown sugar and garlic.
8. Garnish with chopped green onions and serve with lime wedges on the side.
